title: A Test with Cloth
paras: In [[june|June]], Mina visited a small history museum for a [[geography|geography]] [[lesson|lesson]]. The group looked at a map and old clothes from different places. Some clothes had colours made from plants. Mina had a question. Could [[salt|salt]] help these colours stay bright? The teacher did not give her an answer. Instead, they planned a small test with cloth and plant water.

They got leaves from a red cabbage in the museum [[garden|garden]]. The teacher cooked them in water. The water was [[purple|purple]]. When it was cold, Mina put some in each of two glass [[bottle|bottles]]. She added one spoon of salt to only one. Then she put a white [[piece|piece]] of cloth in each. Both stayed in the water for one hour.

Mina took the cloth out and put it by a sunny window. Each day, she [[turn|turned]] both bits of cloth so each side got light. After a week, the colour on both was very pale. The salt did not keep the colour bright in this test. Mina wrote about the test in her [[pink|pink]] notebook. She drew the two bottles and put the date under her drawing.
zh: 六月，米娜来到一家小型历史博物馆上一节地理课。大家看了一张地图和来自不同地方的旧衣服。有些衣服的颜色来自植物。米娜有个问题：盐能帮助这些颜色保持鲜艳吗？老师没有回答她的问题，而是和大家一起计划用布和植物煮出的水做一个小实验。
他们从博物馆的菜园里取来一些紫甘蓝叶子。老师把叶子放进水里煮，水变成了紫色。水凉后，米娜往两个玻璃瓶里分别倒了一些。她只在其中一瓶里加了一勺盐，然后在每个瓶子里放了一块白布。两块布都在水里泡了一个小时。
米娜取出布，把它们放在一扇有阳光照进来的窗边。她每天都翻动两块布，让每一面都能照到光。一周后，两块布上的颜色都很淡了。在这次实验中，盐没有让颜色保持鲜艳。米娜在她的粉红色笔记本里记录了这个实验。她画了那两个瓶子，并在画的下面写上日期。

q.s: Mina went to the museum by bus.
q.why: 文章未说明米娜如何去博物馆。

q.s: Mina put salt in only one bottle.
q.why: 她只在其中一个瓶子里加了一勺盐。

q.s: The salt kept the cloth's colour bright in this test.
q.why: 原文明说盐在此次实验中未保持颜色鲜艳。
